metadata.provenance: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (PIP), version 20250930 (2021 PPP), India national survey-year estimates.
metadata.method: Survey-year headcount at the $3.00/day line (2021 PPP), pulled with fill_gaps=false so only real survey points are kept, not interpolated or projected years. This is the canonical PIP series; the WDI SI.POV.* codes are a rounded snapshot of it and the Poverty & Equity Brief is a hand-readable extract.
metadata.caveat: PIP serves India at national level only; rural/urban splits and the brief's group cuts are not available here and remain sourced from the October 2025 Poverty & Equity Brief. PIP and the WDI API can differ by a rounding step because WDI lags PIP.
